body_html:
Keith is our Philadelphia native who has been spinning tracks and emceeing events since Y2K! With a natural love for people and a constant positive vibe, he loves his ability to create an energy to a room and loves the feelings and emotions generated through song! Even better, Keith is an avid Karaoke host and loves to sing himself. He likes to rap! In his off time Keith loves to spend as much time as possible with his wife and two children, along with his passion for motivational speaking.

In His Headphones: R&B, Pop, Afro Beats, Rap & Reggae
